# Wandershops

Wandershops is a mobile platform for discovering local shops and their products in your neighborhood.

## About
Wandershops connects customers with nearby stores. Vendors list their products with prices, images, and contact information. Customers can browse, discover, and order via WhatsApp directly from the app or web.

## Store Pages
/web/shop/{slug} — Individual store page with product listings, opening hours, location, ratings, and WhatsApp contact info.

## Product Pages
/web/product/{id} — Individual product page with images, pricing, description, store info, and direct WhatsApp ordering.

## Sitemap
/sitemap.xml — Full index of all active store and product pages.
